Text: Hydrochlorothiazide starts to work within 2 hours of a dose, with the peak effect at about 4 hours. The increase in urine output lasts for around 6 to 12 hours, while the medicine's overall action on the body can persist for up to 24 hours.
Lowering blood pressure takes longer than the fluid effect, and your doctor will usually reassess your blood pressure after a few weeks rather than straight away.
The medicine is well absorbed, is not broken down by the body, and is cleared by the kidneys, with most of a dose passing out unchanged in the urine. Its half-life, meaning the time for blood levels to fall by half, has been reported as 6 to 15 hours. In people with kidney disease, levels in the blood are higher and the medicine stays in the body longer.
Hydrochlorothiazide controls high blood pressure but does not cure it. Keep taking it even if you feel well, because high blood pressure often causes no symptoms.

The relation 'has patient instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients taking the subject drug are advised to follow the specified instruction to ensure effective treatment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has missed dose instruction': If a dose of the subject drug is missed the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires patient adherence to': Patients must consistently follow the lifestyle or treatment regimen specified by the object entity to achieve optimal outcomes.
E. 'has indication for initial dose': The subject drug's initial dose is indicated for the specified medical purpose or condition.
